verdict.rationale: Lithic's Auth Rules v2 engine lets users define rules on attributes such as MCC, country, currency and risk score, applied at program, account or card level. These rules are evaluated automatically against multiple event streams (card authorizations, 3DS, tokenization, ACH receipts), with shadow mode and backtesting. AI agents can configure the rules through the official MCP server. missing for 10: actions beyond authorization decisioning (approve/decline) are undocumented, rule-definition syntax and action types are not detailed, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
